visualCharacteristics.structure: text column (H2 + paragraph + outlined CTA) + large image column
visualCharacteristics.description: Two columns ~50/50 on desktop inside a full-width light-grey band (section style light-grey); text column vertically centred on the left; large landscape photo fills the right column; outlined (hollow) button; stacks on mobile with image first.

contentPattern.structure: Single row: text cell (H2, paragraph, CTA link) | media cell (image, optionally linked). Cells may be authored in either order.
